context_requirements: Expression of urate transporters (SLC22A12, SLC22A6, SLC22A8, SLC22A11, SLCO1C1) or other annotated targets at levels sufficient to mediate a transcriptional response
Presence of a urate/transport substrate flux that can be modulated in these cell lines
Intact downstream signaling from the annotated targets (e.g., PANX1, ABCC1, FPR1) to transcriptional effectors
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines after treatment
Evidence that the transcriptional response is abolished by knockout or knockdown of SLC22A12, SLC22A6, SLC22A8, SLC22A11, SLCO1C1, ABCC1, PANX1, or FPR1
